subject: Animation
title: Dynamation: Harryhausen's Secret Weapon
description: A fast breakdown of Dynamation: Harryhausen's Secret Weapon for builders.

hook.text: Harryhausen invented Dynamation, a technique that seamlessly placed stop-motion creatures into live footage.

buildup.text: He split the film frame into layers. Live-action actors occupied one layer, puppets occupied another.

discovery.text: The result made creatures appear to walk among real actors, creating a convincing shared space.

twist.text: Harryhausen animated almost every creature entirely by himself, working alone in his studio for months.

climax.text: Dynamation gave low-budget films the illusion of epic spectacle that audiences had never seen before.

punchline.text: One man in a room made monsters walk among humans.

quiz.question: What was Dynamation?
options: An early form of computer animation
Harryhausen's technique for seamlessly compositing stop-motion creatures into live-action footage
